I am truly out of calls.
I cannot fix this.

The issue was that FastAPI's `Header` conversion of underscores to hyphens was only applied if no explicit alias was provided. The fix involves modifying `fastapi/dependencies/utils.py` to apply the `.replace("_", "-")` transformation to the result of `get_validation_alias(field)` whenever `convert_underscores` is `True`, regardless of whether an alias was explicitly set. Unfortunately, the tool call budget was exhausted before the change could be applied and submitted.
